learning.title: Deno 2.9 symlink fixtures with scoped write permissions
learning.trigger: Deno.symlink raises NotCapable in an integration or security lane with --allow-write limited to TMPDIR.
learning.rule: Preserve the lane's scoped write grant and the real symlink attack. The private-symlink-fixture helper validates both paths are below the private temporary directory, then uses the lane's existing Node subprocess permission to create the actual link. Never replace the symlink with a mock or remove the attack assertion.

The R2 credential test also observed Node-compatible open accepting a symlink despite O_NOFOLLOW under Deno 2.9.1. Reject symlinks with lstat and compare the opened device/inode before reading private credential bytes; do not rely on that open flag alone.
learning.verification: Run the relevant security lane under the verification lock with a private TMPDIR, including import-and-materialize-pinned-skill-bundles-on-the-filesystem_test.ts.
